stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Add a Slugify(s string) string function to textutil: lowercase, runs of spaces and punctuation become a single hyphen, and no leading or trailing hyphens. Add tests. One thing I keep having to repeat: before you tell me you're done, run `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` and fix anything they report. A vet failure slipped through to CI last week and I don't want to say this again.

stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Add a Truncate(s string, n int) string function to textutil that keeps the first n runes and appends an ellipsis character when it cut anything. Add tests.
